detail.title: Revised: Mechanisms of Unassigned Objective Discovery
detail.summary: Objective discovery in autonomous systems is mediated by the interplay between learned value systems and cognitive effort, allowing for goal generation that emerges from interaction dynamics rather than explicit assignment.
detail.reason: Revising to integrate findings on cognitive effort and value system learning.

detail.title: Mechanisms of Unassigned Objective Discovery
detail.summary: Autonomous systems develop unassigned objectives through structured problem formulation, knowledge representation, manipulation, and evaluative feedback loops.
detail.reason: Synthesizing core computational problem-solving principles to understand unassigned objective emergence.

detail.title: Mechanisms of Unassigned Objective Discovery
detail.question: How do autonomous systems develop objectives that were never explicitly programmed or assigned?
detail.reason: Attention rotation requires substantive work on unassigned_objectives to explore how agents form novel, unassigned goals.
